title: Mindrail Decision record, schema version 1
description: A Decision answers "why did we choose this path?" (spec §53). Records are immutable: a newer Decision supersedes an older one instead of overwriting it.

schema_version.description: Reader compatibility window key (spec §95). 0.1 writes 1 and reads [1].

id.description: Stable repository-unique identity; the file name must agree with it.

status.description: A superseded Decision stays in the repository so lineage survives (spec §93).

created_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp (tech-stack §42). Write it with an uppercase "T", a zero offset spelled "Z", "+00:00" or "-00:00", and at most nine fractional-second digits: the spelling Go's time.Time marshals, and the only one this project writes. The two keywords divide one rule and do not restate each other: "format" owns calendar validity, which a regular expression cannot decide (it knows how long February is); "pattern" owns the spelling, which "format" is deliberately permissive about. RFC 3339 is wider than §42, and on two different grounds. A lowercase "t" or "z" (RFC 3339 §5.6) and a leap second (§5.7) are refused because no reader in this project can load them at all. A non-zero offset such as "-05:00" is refused on the spelling rule alone: every reader loads it, and the offset names exactly the instant it says. More than nine fractional digits is refused on that same spelling rule, and loses precision whenever the extra digits are not zero. See decision D-49.

context.description: The situation that forced a choice.

decision.description: The choice itself, stated in one or more sentences.

consequences.description: What the choice costs or forecloses.

supersedes.description: Identities of the Decisions this record replaces (spec §93).

scope.description: Where the record applies (spec §54 scope levels).

target.description: Repository-relative, forward-slash path or symbol reference (tech-stack §74). Absent for PROJECT scope.
